revisionDesc.change: Vote - AcceptText - Accept. See Ast's. Lin1 I'd prefer Ταμαρ̣ήους (rho not very legible in my view). Lin1 agree that Ast's Ψενκήβοκις (l. Ψενκήβκιος) suits traces much better than BL. Encode: <:<:Ψενκήβκιος|reg|Ψενκήβοκις:>=PN R. Ast (digital image)||ed||Ψενκῆβκις=BL 7.237|Ψενκηι̣όκις:>; Lin2-3 cannot in my opinion be ὀκτ̣|ὼν. There is a faded iota between omicron and kappa (Ast points out in discussion over Skype, with image in front of both of us, that the stroke immediately following the nu in μερῶν is elsewhere in this text written over the nu's right hasta; here it is somewhat detached). Moreover, the space at the start of line 3 must include more than just the left half of an omega. Thus, at lin2-3 we have μερῶν οικ.[?]|.ων ; this should be οἰκο̣[πέ]|δ̣ων , which is what the duplicate text has: P.Mich. V 307.2. Encode: <:οἰκο̣[πέ]|δ̣ων=PN J. Sosin (digital image)|ed|<:ὀκ3.- τὼ|reg|ὀκ3.- [τ]ὼν:>:> ; conferred at length with R. Ast, both looking at digital image, and he agrees. Agree with Ast with regard to δημοσίων.

Vote - AcceptText - Line 1: I agree that Ταμαρήους was written here--the round stroke is the bottom of alpha, not omicron; the part of the letter that was taken as a medial sigma is in fact the descender of rho. Τετοσῖρις is doubtlessly correct. The BL reading adopted in line 1, Ψενκῆβκις, does not appear to be right. Instead, read Ψενκήβοκις (l. Ψενκήβκιος). As for ln 2-3, --> ὀκτ̣|ὼν (l. ὀκτ|ὼ) is good, and the rest of the BL entries seem fine. In ln 9 I see no reason to change δημοσίων to δημωσίων. The writer sometimes leaves his omicrons open at the top (cf. ἀπό in line 1 and Τετοσῖρις in line 10); moreover, if it were omega, we would expect to see something of the right bowl.

line 1: Ταμοσηοῦς → Ταμαρήους based on digital image (psi-online.it); cf. the duplicate, P.Mich. V 307 line 1: Τοτοσῖρις → Τετοσῖρις based on digital image (psi-online.it); ed. pr. misread omicron for epsilon line 1: entered BL correction, Ψενκηι̣όκις → Ψενκῆβκις (BL 7.237) line 2-3: ὀκ|[τ]ὼν (l. ὀκ|τὼ) → ὀκτ̣|ὼν (l. ὀκτ|ὼ) based on digital image (psi-online.it); trace of the tau is visible at the end of line 2 line 4: entered two BL corrections: Παψοῖφιν → καὶ Ψοῖφιν (BL 3.226); Μαρενκάμιος → Μαρεπκάμιος (BL 7.237) line 4: Ψο̣[ ̣ ̣ ̣] → Ψο[ίφεως] based on digital image (psi-online.it); assured by the duplicate, P.Mich. V 307.4 line 5: entered BL correction, Μαρενκάμις → Μαρεπκᾶμις (BL 7.237) line 7: entered BL correction, Μ̣αρενκ[άμιος] → Μαρεπκ[ᾶμις] (BL 7.237) line 9: δημοσίων → δημωσίων (l. δημοσίων) based on digital image (psi-online.it); ed. pr. misread omicron for omega
